title: First Exploration of the Ruins
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone held their breath, staring at the stone statue, cracks on its surface began to slowly spread. An ancient and mighty aura spilled out from the fissures—a voice sealed by Heavenly Dao for ten thousand years.

text.content: While Chen Ji was still digesting this shocking information, a tremor came from the end of the secret realm—the aura of the Eye of Heavenly Dao was already close at hand. That oppressive pressure surged like a tide, filling everyone present with an suffocating fear. "Everyone, time is running out." Chen Ji's voice was unexpectedly calm, as if what was approaching was not Heavenly Dao's will, but merely a negligible gust of wind. His gaze fell upon the ancient ruin entrance ahead, where stone doors were covered with mottled runes that glowed with a faint cyan light in the twilight. "We only have two hours. Either we get what we want, or..." He didn't finish, but the meaning was self-evident.

Ye Qing stood beside Chen Ji, demonic path mist swirling gently around her, concealing their group's presence. Her gaze swept across the ruins, a complex expression flickering in her eyes. "This ruin's aura... it's exactly the same as what I've seen recorded in the Holy Sect's ancient texts." She lowered her voice. "Legend has it that this was the cave dwelling left behind by a heaven-defying powerhouse ten thousand years ago, containing secrets capable of overturning the order of Heavenly Dao." Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's heart tightened slightly. Chen Xuan, the creator of the Tianji Record—what had he discovered during his lifetime that made Heavenly Dao so fearful?

At that moment, a low rumble echoed from the stone doors at the ruin's entrance. Everyone instinctively stepped back, watching as a blood-red glow slowly illuminated the indentation in the center of the stone doors, resonating with the mark on Chen Ji's wrist. "As expected..." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a trace of barely perceptible relief. "Chen Xuan's bloodline is the only key. Chen Ji, are you ready? Once you enter this ruin, the karmic connection between you and Chen Xuan can never be severed." Chen Ji didn't answer, but slowly walked forward, pressing his palm against the blood-red indentation. A burning sensation immediately coursed through his palm, as if something within him was awakening.

As the words fell, the blood-red glow violently surged, spreading along the patterns on the stone doors. A moment later, the heavy stone doors slowly opened to both sides, releasing a breath of air that had been sealed for ten thousand years. A blurry image flashed through Chen Ji's mind—it was Chen Xuan standing before these doors, solitary and resolute. But the vision vanished in an instant, and he didn't even have time to see Chen Xuan's expression. "Let's go." Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression unchanged, and stepped into the ruins first. Beyond the doors lay a narrow, elongated corridor, with densely carved runes covering both walls, each rune emanating a faint glow, as if guiding them toward something.

At the end of the corridor was a spacious stone chamber, its walls smooth as mirrors but riddled with countless mechanism holes. The moment Chen Ji stepped inside, a slight vibration came from beneath his feet. "Careful!" Ye Qing's reflexes were swift, pulling Chen Nian beside her backward. Almost simultaneously, dozens of cold beams erupted from the walls,，带着尖锐的破空声，直取众人要害。陈机的眼神微微一凝，天机录在他脑海中飞速运转，那三时辰的预见能力悄然启动——但这一次，他没有选择预知未来，而是将能力聚焦于眼前这间石室的机关轨迹。

choice.prompt: The cold light of mechanisms crisscrossed, time was running short! Chen Ji had to make an immediate decision:

choices.text: Take the risk and go deeper
choices.description: Use the Heavenly Secrets ability to forcibly deduce the mechanism trajectory, leading everyone through the chamber at the fastest speed, but at the cost of some Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Quickly pass through the chamber, preserving the time advantage
choices.risk_hint: Any slight misstep would result in severe injuries from the mechanisms

dialogue.content: "Stay close to me, step where I step!"

text.content: A sharp light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, the patterns of the Tianji Record swirling in the depths of his pupils. The next instant, he moved—his figure ghostlike as he darted through the crisscrossing cold beams, each step precisely avoiding the lethal range of the mechanisms. The people behind him followed closely, their hearts racing as they watched those cold beams narrowly miss them.

choices.description: First observe the mechanism patterns, find the safe path, then proceed steadily—time-consuming but ensuring safety
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao is approaching, time consumption may bring greater risks

text.content: Chen Ji didn't act rashly, but stood quietly at the entrance, his gaze sweeping across the entire chamber. Those seemingly chaotic mechanisms, under the auxiliary analysis of the Tianji Record, gradually revealed their patterns—a three-breath cycle, with the southeast corner being the safe zone. Seeing this, a slight smile curved Ye Qing's lips—this was the Chen Ji she knew, never putting himself in danger.

choices.description: The mechanisms themselves might contain some kind of message, trying to decipher them before acting might yield unexpected gains
choices.visible_reward: May Obtain Hidden Information Left by Chen Xuan
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao Will Not Give You Much Time

dialogue.content: "These mechanisms... aren't lethal traps, they're information."

text.content: "These mechanisms... aren't lethal traps, they're information." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his gaze fixed intently on the trajectories of the mechanisms' projectiles. He discovered that those cold gleams weren't chaotic but formed a certain patterned design—ancient script! "Interesting..." A smile curved Chen Ji's lips, "Chen Xuan used mechanisms as his brush, writing a sentence on the wall." He walked forward slowly, yet precisely stepping on the blank spaces formed by those mechanism trajectories, interpreting as he walked: "'Those who defy heaven are not alone.'" Everyone's expressions instantly became intriguing.

After passing through the first stone chamber, the group arrived at a spiraling staircase descending downward. Ancient murals hung on both sides of the stairs, depicting an earth-shattering great battle—with immortal-like cultivators, giant hands blocking the sky, and countless destiny threads forcibly severed. Chen Ji paused to observe, feeling an inexplicable sense of familiarity rising in his heart. "This is..." Chen Nian suddenly spoke, her voice trembling slightly, "This is the scene of Heavenly Dao eliminating dissidents. I can sense... each severed destiny thread represents a prophet erased by Heavenly Dao."

dialogue.content: "So was Chen Xuan one of them?" Ye Qing's voice carried a weight of gravity, "After discovering the secrets of Heavenly Dao, he chose to resist?"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer, continuing down the stairs. As he descended deeper, the murals on the walls gradually transformed—from the initial war scenes to images of Chen Xuan alone, researching the Tianji Record. He witnessed Chen Xuan spending sleepless nights deducing Heavenly Secrets, the shock and fury when he discovered the truth of the Tianji Record, and his resolute determination when leaving all this behind in the ruins. "He's warning those who come after." Chen Ji murmured, "The Tianji Record... it's not merely a prophetic tool."

The end of the staircase led to a second stone chamber, broader and more perilous than the first. The mechanisms here were no longer simple cold light, but a bizarre gray mist surging from all directions, making defense nearly impossible. More troublesome was that this mist interfered with spiritual awareness, significantly weakening one's perceptive abilities. "This is... Fate's Mist!" Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly, "One of the Holy Sect's forbidden techniques, supposedly capable of blocking all causal perception. Even the abilities of the Tianji Record would be greatly diminished within it!"

Chen Ji closed his eyes, sensing the gray mist's interference with the Tianji Record. Indeed, the previously clear foresight images became blurry, like being covered by a veil. But he didn't panic; instead, a cold smile curved his lips. "Fate's Mist?" he murmured softly, "Good, I also want to see what remains when fate is obscured." He slowly opened his eyes, the patterns flowing in his pupils different from before—ancient, primitive power that seemed to bypass the layer of fate entirely, pointing directly to essence.

dialogue.content: "Brother... your eye color changed." Chen Nian's voice carried worry, yet also a strange sense of familiarity.

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji reached up and brushed his eyes, the bizarre pupil change vanishing instantly. "You saw wrong." His voice was calm as always, but his heart churned. In that moment, he had felt a summons of some power—from deep within the Tianji Record, from the mark Chen Xuan left behind. It was a force transcending Heavenly Fate and causality, completely opposite to the order represented by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. "Let's go, this mist can't stop us." He lifted his foot and walked directly into the gray mist. Strangely, the moment he stepped into the mist, the vapor automatically parted to both sides, as if submitting to him.

choice.prompt: The mist automatically parted, Chen Ji's special physique revealed? At this moment he can choose:

choices.text: Follow the momentum and advance deeper
choices.description: Since the mist has made way, charge forward directly, crossing the stone chamber at the fastest speed

dialogue.content: "This mist... seems to be afraid of you?"

text.content: Ye Qing followed at Chen Ji's side, the Demonic Path mist and this Fate's Mist repelling each other, yet forming a wondrous balance around Chen Ji. For the first time, she gazed at this "waste" with an almost scrutinizing gaze—the secrets on this fellow were probably far more numerous than she had imagined.

choices.description: The mist parting is too suspicious, order everyone to hold position, first use spiritual awareness to scout the situation ahead
choices.visible_reward: Safe and may discover hidden mechanisms

text.content: Chen Ji didn't charge forward recklessly. Instead, he signaled for everyone to halt. He crouched down, his fingers gently touching the ground, feeling the faint vibrations beneath the stone slabs. "There's something underneath..." His eyes narrowed slightly. "Another formation—ten times more complex than the last one." Ye Qing sucked in a breath. Had Chen Ji not stopped them in time, they would have triggered a lethal formation capable of annihilating a Golden Core cultivator.

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly as he sensed the aura emanating from the stone statue—a perfect match to the Tianji Record, yet fundamentally opposed. The Heavenly Eye symbolized order, control, absolute dominion over fate; whereas this statue embodied... "Freedom." Master Mo's voice suddenly resonated in his mind, carrying an unprecedented gravity. "Chen Ji, this represents the other half of the Tianji Record—the Spirit's dwelling. It stands as a perfect mirror to the Heavenly Eye—one signifying control, the other liberation. When Chen Xuan divided the Tianji Record in two, he harbored a hope that someday, someone would reunite them, shattering the Heaven's monopoly entirely."

Chen Ji stood quietly before the stone statue, his gaze complex. "So... the Tianji Record has always been exploited by the Heaven?" His voice was soft, yet the fury within was unmistakable. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before speaking: "To be precise, the Tianji Record itself is a piece on the Heaven's chessboard. It grants prophets the ability to glimpse Heavenly Secrets, allowing them to believe they control fate while actually strengthening the Heaven's grip on destiny step by step. Every prophet is merely nourishment for the Heaven."

dialogue.content: "And me?" Chen Ji's voice turned icy cold. "Am I also... fodder?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng offered no direct response, only saying: "You differ from others. When Chen Xuan created the Tianji Record, he deliberately left a contingency—injecting his own bloodline, Heavenly Fate, and unfinished wishes into the record's core. That's why you can use the Tianji Record without suffering its backlash. You are not the Heaven's pawn, but... the inheritor." Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips curved into a bitter smile. Inheritor? It sounded glorious, but who could truly comprehend the immense burden it carried?

Just then, a beam of light suddenly illuminated the ground before the stone statue. An ancient stone platform rose from the earth, bearing a yellowed silk scroll inscribed with four bold characters—"Tianji Record: Fourth Volume." Chen Ji's heart jolted. He strode forward, only to find the silk's message sparse yet profound: "To break the shackles, three elements must unite: the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, the Key of Fate, and the Heart of Heavenly Fate. Without even one, the shackles cannot be shattered." The Eye of Heavenly Secrets was clearly the Tianji Record itself. The Key of Fate... Chen Ji's gaze instinctively drifted toward Chen Nian not far away. And what exactly was the Heart of Heavenly Fate?

choice.prompt: The fourth page of the Tianji Record revealed crucial intelligence: Chen Nian was precisely the "Key of Fate"! Now Chen Ji faced a critical choice:

choices.description: "My sister has the right to know the secrets hidden within her. Let her participate in the subsequent decisions."
choices.visible_reward: "Enhance team cohesion; Chen Nian's cooperation will increase"
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Nian might develop psychological burdens from learning the truth"

text.content: Chen Ji pulled Chen Nian to the stone platform, pointing out the scroll's contents for her to see. After reading it, Chen Nian's eyes reddened slightly, yet she did not cry. "So... the Holy Sect has been hunting me all this time because of this?" Her voice was soft, yet unexpectedly calm. Chen Ji's heart ached. Just as he moved to comfort her, Chen Nian cut him off: "Brother, you don't need to explain. I've always known something special existed within me." She lifted her gaze, a hint of stubbornness within her eyes. "Since the Key of Fate is the key, then I'll serve as the key."

choices.memory_label: 陈念对自己的身份有了清晰认知，并表示愿意配合

choices.description: "Cannot let Chen Nian bear too much. I'll shoulder this secret alone and wait until the timing is right."
choices.visible_cost: "Information asymmetry may trigger a trust crisis"
choices.visible_reward: "Protect Chen Nian's psychological state; preserve strategic flexibility."
choices.risk_hint: "If Chen Nian discovers the concealment, it may backfire."

dialogue.content: "This is only partial information. I'm still studying it."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the silk scroll into his sleeve, his expression betraying no flaw. Though Chen Nian sensed something unusual about her brother, she did not press further. Ye Qing watched the scene from the side, her lips curving slightly—this fellow, despite his inner turmoil, still managed to appear completely composed. Indeed, a master actor.

choices.description: "Ye Qing is the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path. Perhaps she knows clues about the "Heart of Heavenly Fate.""
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might use this to drive a bargain

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing, have you heard of the 'Heart of Heavenly Fate'?"

text.content: Hearing this, Ye Qing's expression slightly changed. "The Heart of Heavenly Fate..." She pondered for a moment, "I saw this name in the Holy Sect's forbidden texts. It is said that during ancient times, the Heavenly Dao, in order to control all living beings, specially gouged out the heart from a power who defied heaven. That heart contained the purest 'power of defying heaven,' but was also sealed away by the Heavenly Dao with great divine magic somewhere." Chen Ji's gaze slightly tensed. "You mean... the Heart of Heavenly Fate is inside this ruins?"

At this moment, a low rumbling sound echoed through the hall. Fine cracks began to appear on the surface of the stone statue, and silvery-white light seeped through the crevices. Meanwhile, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record violently shaking in his Mental Sea, as if sensing some kind of summoning. "What's happening?" Ye Qing's face changed, demonic energy condensing in her hands as she warily observed the statue's transformation. Yet Chen Ji remained still, for he could sense—the aura emanating from the statue carried no hostility, only a desperate... call.

Right then, an earth-shaking roar burst from beyond the ruins, the ground violently quaking as dust fell in sheets. Chen Ji's expression shifted—the presence of the Heavenly Dao's Eye grew more intense, more oppressive than before. "It's found this place." Ye Qing's voice carried a grave weight. "It won't be long before it shatters the ruins' barrier." Chen Ji drew a sharp breath, his gaze darting between the stone statue and the exit. The Heavenly Dao's Eye pressed close, yet mysteries lay hidden within the statue's depths, and time was slipping away like sand through fingers.

Chen Ji advanced toward the stone statue with measured steps, each footfall landing on the nodes of destiny. As he reached its presence, the fractures had spread across its face, revealing crystalline silver luminescence within—not stone, but something beyond comprehension: the true form of the Tianji Record's spirit, the free will that had clashed with the Heavenly Dao's Eye for millennia. "Heir of Chen Xuan..." A voice, ancient and commanding, resounded in Chen Ji's mind. "You have finally arrived."

dialogue.content: "Who are you?" Chen Ji's voice remained calm, yet his vigilance had reached its peak.

text.content: "I am the other half of the Tianji Record—the spirit." The voice answered. "I am also 'freedom' itself, sealed by the Heavenly Dao for ten thousand years. When Chen Xuan separated me from the Tianji Record in your hands, it was so that someday, someone could reunite us." A note of satisfaction entered the spirit's voice. "You possess Chen Xuan's bloodline, the recognition of the Tianji Record, and..." Its voice paused. "A heart unbound by fate. You are the one who can shatter the Heavenly Dao's monopoly."

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment before asking, "The three objects as one—how exactly is this accomplished?" The spirit's voice resonated once more: "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets rests in your grasp, the Key of Destiny stands by your side—your sister, the Heart of Heavenly Fate..." Its voice turned grave. "The Heart of Heavenly Fate is the very heart carved from me by the Heavenly Dao. It lies sealed within the deepest forbidden chamber of these ruins, guarded personally by the Heavenly Dao's Eye." Chen Ji's gaze tightened. "Then... to obtain the Heart of Heavenly Fate, one must face the Heavenly Dao's Eye?"

"Precisely." The spirit's voice carried weight. "The Heavenly Dao's Eye has been waiting for this moment. It deliberately guided you to these ruins, only to..." Before the words could finish, the stone statue violently convulsed, an overwhelming force erupting from the cracks and hurling Chen Ji backward several steps. Simultaneously, a blinding radiance poured through the ruins' entrance, followed by a familiar, crushing pressure. "Chen Ji..." The voice was ice-cold and commanding, dripping with contemptuous scrutiny. "This one has waited for you quite some time."

The Heavenly Dao's Eye had finally revealed itself. Chen Ji turned slowly, gazing upon the entity emerging from the light—a illusory eye, suspended in midair, its pupil swirling with countless threads of causality, each one representing a strand of destiny's tapestry. It possessed no physical form, yet was more suffocating than any corporeal being. "Do you believe that coming to these ruins will grant you the means to break fate?" The Heavenly Dao's Eye spoke with biting mockery. "How laughable. From the moment you acquired the Tianji Record, you became a piece on this one's chessboard."

dialogue.content: "A piece?" A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "If I am merely a piece, then why come yourself?" His gaze turned blade-sharp, piercing directly at the spectral eye. "Heavenly Dao... are you afraid?"

text.content: At this critical juncture, the stone statue shattered completely, and a silver-white figure erupted skyward, placing itself before Chen Ji. It was a humanoid silhouette wreathed in countless chains, yet emanating an aura utterly contrary to the Heavenly Dao's Eye—freedom, liberation, the indomitable will unbound by any power. "Your opponent is me." The spirit's voice rang cold and resolute. "Heavenly Dao, the grievances between us end today!" Two terrifying entities faced each other in the air, and the entire ruins quivered violently. Chen Ji understood—the true battle was about to commence.
